purpose: Test whether the already-defined material geometry-objective conflict marker remains informative when the source and target data instances change.

data_instance_protocol.source_target_sampling: independent unlabeled random sampling without replacement
data_instance_protocol.stored_provenance: source_indices and target_indices in each output JSON

primary_outputs: ROCA branch correctness among all data instances
wrong ROCA selections rejected by the marker
analysis_protocol.interpretation_rule: No threshold, seed, solver setting, or sample size will be changed after inspecting these five outputs. If no incorrect ROCA selection occurs, report that selective-error calibration remains untested rather than claiming success.
